text: Its spine was flush with the steel edge. The same situation as the other Thursdays. He pulled it free, the cover was stuck with a square of blue prescription notepad. In ball point ink it said "The baker in chapter five reminds me of you. Thank you for keeping the lights on." He traced the deep indentation from the pen. The compressor shudder was the only sound. From the back, a slip of paper, due date card, yellowing, stamped in faded red ink, three days overdue. He walked over to the prep table, wrapped a warm glaze mapped cinnamon roll up in parchment paper, and put it in his coat pocket with the book.
